name: custompage-delete
description: A custom page delete skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. It is used to move one or more custom pages to the recycle bin under a specified site language.

language.description: Required. Exact site language code to delete from, such as `en` or `fr`.

id_list.description: Required. Custom page ID list, up to 100 items.

confirmation.description: Required. Proof that the user explicitly approved this exact custom page delete request after seeing the final language and custom page IDs.

approved.description: Must be `true` only after the user explicitly confirms the language and exact custom page IDs to be moved to the recycle bin.

summary.description: Required confirmation note that restates the language and exact custom page IDs shown to the user before execution.

status.description: Request status. `true` indicates success and `false` indicates failure.
